title: Howard H. Stevenson Professor of Business Administration Peter O. Crisp Faculty Chair, Harvard Innovation Labs
bio: HBS Foundry HBS Foundry is an AI-driven platform that accelerates the likelihood of venture success for high-potential entrepreneurs who want to make a difference in the world. It supports entrepreneurs from idea through initial funding and growth by leveraging Harvard Business School's faculty expertise, knowledge assets, and extensive alumni and investor networks.
